node.title: PROVED (X-5): the star-PTE normal form — no non-PTE cancellation exists
node.statement: For any family of monic degree-A locators with roots in D sharing top t coefficients, and any base member S0: every member S decomposes canonically as S = C u P, S0 = C u Q with |P| = |Q| >= t+1 (unless S = S0) and e_r(P) = e_r(Q) for r <= t. Proof: L_S - L_S0 = L_C (L_P - L_Q); the degree constraint forces the top-t agreement; h <= t forces L_P = L_Q. Exact, scale-free, transports verbatim to quotient rows. CONSEQUENCE: there is no non-PTE cancellation mechanism at the two-locator level — any residual hardness is COMPRESSION of many trades, not representation.
node.notes: PROVENANCE: GPT Pro X-5 (demolition brief), verified here. Also the tautology catch: unrestricted PTE stripping makes literal U1 trivially true (remainder <= 1) — my U1 wording had a definitional flaw that would have made a 'proof' vacuous; caught pre-investment.
